name: Console
title: Templates/Shells/Console
summary: The console shell as one component: `ConsoleLayout`, composed once in the app around RouterView, so a console page is only its body. Its `navigation` is the Azion console tree as data (Overview, Workloads, Deployments; Build, Secure, Store, Observe; Marketplace and the Settings drill-in), each row with a router `to`, and the active row follows the route; it renders the resizable, collapsible rail with the wordmark and the account at its foot, the header with breadcrumbs, the search trigger, the app's actions and the avatar, the ⌘K palette listing every navigation page, and the single main. Below 768 px of its own width the rail becomes a drawer opened from the header's menu button. This block fills the slots: Create (`Button`) and Agent (`ButtonHighlight`), icon-only (`IconButton` with a `Tooltip`) while compact; Recents and Actions as `Command` groups; the account menu (`DropdownMenu` with `ThemeSwitcher`, Upgrade to Pro and `StatusIndicator`). The body is a stand-in list page (`PageHeader`, Filter, a search `Input`, the toolbar and a `Card`) for platform/view/table-view; a page opens the same palette with useConsoleLayout().openSearch().

variants.name: DetailPage
variants.summary: A resource detail page rendered through `ConsoleLayout`: its `breadcrumbs` slot composes a `Breadcrumb` that reads Applications, the application, then its environment as a `Select` that searches the environments, tags each with its deployment policy and offers Add Environment at its foot; the default slot opens flush on a full-bleed `PageTabs` with the Overview, Deployments and Settings tabs and the outlined Deploy action, which stays in view while the tab content scrolls under it.

variants.name: Notifications
variants.summary: The ListPage rendered through `ConsoleLayout` with a bell in its `actions` slot: the bell carries an unread `Badge` and toggles the layout's tools region (`v-model:tools-open`, titled Notifications, a drawer on a narrow screen), whose `tools` slot lists deploys, invitations and alerts with Mark all as read and Clear all and offers Edit and Redeploy on each deploy; a failed deploy also shows as a flash `Alert` in the `notifications` slot above the page, and an empty list reads You are all caught up through `EmptyState`.

variants.name: AccountSwitch
variants.summary: The ListPage rendered through `ConsoleLayout` with the account switcher in its `header-start` slot (square `Avatar`, the account name, a chevron; avatar and chevron only while compact; Ctrl+O or ⌘O): a large `Dialog` with search over the organization, group and workspace `Table` tree (expand and collapse, type, ID and client ID), the current account marked, a toast on switch, and Account settings in the footer.
